pillars.heading: Shared backbone
pillars.body: Reusable Astro/Tailwind packages provide routes, layouts, content schemas, design tokens, override surfaces, admin tools, and deployment conventions.

pillars.heading: Consumer-contributors
pillars.body: Site owners contribute needs, feedback, examples, and acceptance criteria. They do not need to become framework experts to shape the system they use.

pillars.heading: Agent-safe workflow
pillars.body: Scoped GitHub issues, package boundaries, visual QA, CI, and human review make AI-assisted implementation useful without handing the project over to automation.

ctaBody: Explore the architecture, inspect the feature matrix, or open a GitHub issue with a reusable site need. The goal is a shared commons where every good contribution improves the backbone for everyone.
